comments.body: is there any other way to get this besides buying it at those places?

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
Each of the four Private Farm locations has a chance to provide this trade good. The farms and their assorted "tables" can be examined from here:

Private Farm

comments.author: Wystein
comments.body:
Technically like almost all trade goods it is also possible to plunder it from npc fleets although if you want it in quantity I can't recommend it.

And it can be found using the procurement skill in some locations.
